land.text: Durrës, which Karl Thopia took from the Angevins in March 1368 and which made him recognised as Prince of Albania

predecessors.note: The page: the principality "succeeded" the Angevin Kingdom of Albania, whose rule in Albania Karl's capture of Durrës ended. Before 1368 the core was the county of Mat.

land.text: the principality "conquer[ed]" by the Ottomans in 1415 and "incorporate[d] ... into the Sanjak of Albania"

successors.note: Durrës had passed to Venice in 1392 (Venetian Albania).

capitals.name: Durrës (Durazzo)
capitals.note: Infobox capital: Durrës, held by the Thopias only 1368-1382 and 1385-1392; Krujë was their stronghold from 1363.

correction.text: the county of Mat, inherited by Karl Thopia on his father Tanusio's death in 1359

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe; Cliopatria has no row (its Albanian Principalities row begins in 1375). The page names Mat (Tanusio, Count of Mat from 1328) without a boundary; the 25 km circle round Burrel is the researcher's reading. Area: page silent.
"April 1362-May 1363: Karl's first siege of Durrës fails. By 1363 he holds Krujë and nearby territory."
"March 1368: Karl takes Durrës from the Angevins. Venice recognizes him as Prince of Albania."

correction.text: at its maximum extent "between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers" after taking the Muzaka lands

keyframe_review.note: "c. 1370: Karl takes Muzaka territory, reaching his maximum extent between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers." The Albanian counties are the researcher's reading (about 9,100 km2 on the cell grid); the page gives no area.

correction.text: without Durrës, which Balša II seized in 1382

keyframe_review.note: "1382: Balša II seizes Durrës." The Angevin Kingdom page has Thopia regaining it "probably in 1383" and Balša II capturing it again in 1385-1388; this dossier follows the principality page, which has Balša II killed at Savra in 1385.

correction.text: with Durrës regained after the Battle of Savra, in which Balša II was killed in 1385

keyframe_review.note: The Savra victory is the page's; it does not say in as many words that Durrës returned, so the return in 1385 is the researcher's reading (confidence 2 in the ledger).

correction.text: without Durrës, which Gjergj surrendered to Venice in the summer of 1392

keyframe_review.note: "Summer 1392: Gjergj surrenders Durrës to Venice." The page gives no extent for 1392-1415 apart from Krujë (Balsha 1394-1402, Niketa from 1402); the Albanian counties are carried forward.

ledger.note: 1359: Tanusio Thopia dies and Karl Thopia succeeds him as Count of Mat; the page's infobox dates the principality from 1359, although Venice recognises him as Prince of Albania only in 1368.

ledger.counterpart: Krujë (previous holder not named by the page)
ledger.note: 1363: "By 1363 he holds Krujë and nearby territory", after the failed siege of Durrës (April 1362 to May 1363).
March 1368: Karl Thopia takes Durrës and is recognised by Venice as Prince of Albania.

region.text: the Muzaka territory, giving his maximum extent "between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers"

ledger.note: c. 1370: Karl takes the Muzaka lands and reaches his maximum extent.
1382: Balša II of Zeta seizes Durrës.

region.text: Durrës, after the Battle of Savra near Lushnjë

ledger.note: 1385: Karl appeals to Murad I, an Ottoman force under Hayreddin Pasha intervenes and Balša II is killed at the Battle of Savra; the page does not name the return of Durrës in so many words.
Summer 1392: Gjergj surrenders Durrës to Venice and dies that September.

region.text: the principality, incorporated into the Sanjak of Albania

ledger.note: 1415: the Ottomans conquer the principality and incorporate it into the Sanjak of Albania.

wars.name: Thopia-Balšić war for Durrës

zones.text: Durrës and the plain round Lushnjë

wars.outcome: Balša II seized Durrës in 1382; with Murad I's help Karl Thopia killed him at the Battle of Savra near Lushnjë in 1385.
wars.note: The Angevin Kingdom page puts Balša II's capture of Durrës in 1385-1388 and Thopia's return in 1383, a disagreement kept in the keyframe note.

wars.name: Thopia siege of Durrës
wars.outcome: Karl's first siege failed (April 1362 to May 1363); he took Durrës from the Angevins in March 1368.

certainty.note: A baronial principality with no frontier on the page except the Shkumbin and Seman rivers at its maximum extent.

notes: Cliopatria has no row; flagged by eu-18-e as needing a dossier. One page opened plus the Angevin Albania page already read. Gaps: the extent after 1388 (page silent apart from Krujë), Kavaja, Tirana and Kastrioti (page silent), the 1432 events, the Ottoman suzerainty claim of 1385 (not recorded as a vassal relation). Disagreement: Durrës in 1376-1383 and 1382-1385 (rulers table against main text; the Angevin Kingdom page). Counterparts needing dossiers: muzaka-despotate-of-berat (eu-18-e).
